scope: Proposition 7.4 (Affiliated positive mean) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Xn, n ∈ Z, be positive affiliated units in a finite von Neumann algebra. Suppose that both {Xn} and {X−1 n } are tight. There is a unique positive affiliated unit P satisfying MnF(P, Xn) = 1 2 1. (7.7) The construction is covariant under congruence by affiliated invertible operators, including affiliated invertible maps between corners with their restricted traces.
